item.title: UK Account Executive - SMB
item.description:
Let's build the future together!

Teamtailor is an Employer Branding and an ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250.000 users in 90 countries around the world.

Working at Teamtailor means working at a global, international, and fast-paced tech company that offers an ideal workplace for those who want to have a real impact on the growth of an organisation and are craving for responsibilities. It also means having lots of fun!!! 🥳

Building a diverse team with various backgrounds and expertise is at the core of Teamtailor since its very beginning, and is truly a part of our strength today! There are no typical profiles, except that every team member shares our vision and wants to be part of our success. Join us in our mission to help companies and people interact with each other in a better way so that they can make life-changing decisions together.

We are now looking for an Account Executive to join the team from our Farringdon office - this role is perfect for someone who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and loves building their own book of business!

We work hard and have lots of fun along the way, but every call counts, and we're looking for someone who takes real accountability for their numbers and stays proactive about hitting them, not just aiming for them. You will be instrumental in driving Teamtailor's growth across the SMB+Mid-Market segment, running high-velocity sales cycles from first contact through to close.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership and accountability of your pipeline and your numbers, treating every call and every deal as if it's the one that matters most

  • Build and nurture your own book of business through proactive, self-generated, multi-channel outreach, never waiting for pipeline to come to you

  • Run structured, consultative discovery and use MEDDPICC diligently to qualify every opportunity

  • Manage a high volume of fast-moving deals with a high degree of detail and accuracy

  • Keep pipeline hygiene and CRM data clean, accurate and up to date at all times, no exceptions

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations tailored to each prospect's needs

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success and the wider Sales team to ensure smooth handovers at close

  • Provide reliable weekly and monthly forecasts you can be held to

  • Consistently and proactively hit your monthly and quarterly revenue targets, and take ownership when a number is at risk rather than waiting to be asked

  • Bring your experience selling in the tech space to help upskill the wider team

We are looking for someone with:

  • A track record of selling in the tech space, ideally SaaS, with a genuine passion for sharing that knowledge with the team

  • Experience working in a high-performance, target-driven sales culture, where you're comfortable being held to your numbers

  • A strong sense of personal accountability and ownership - you treat your pipeline like your own business and don't need to be chased to stay on top of it

  • Genuinely proactive by nature - you spot when a number is slipping and act on it before anyone has to flag it

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing several fast-moving deals at once

  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar qualification framework

  • Excellent pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline (Salesforce & Gong experience preferred)

  • Emotional intelligence and strong communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships with prospects

  • An inquisitive, hungry mindset - always looking to improve and develop

  • The ability to take feedback well and act on it quickly

  • A team-first attitude, willing to share knowledge and support colleagues

What we have to offer:

  • The opportunity to sell the market's leading employer branding and recruitment platform

  • Fixed salary together with a variable commission plan, we apply a generous model with no cap

  • Company pension

  • Development opportunities in a fast-growing environment, continuous training, and support

  • Generous PTO (25 days) and you will be able to attend our yearly 3-day company trip

  • Tons of team events, celebrations, monthly competitions and rewards for those who like challenges

  • Starter kit which includes a Macbook Air, iPhone, and the must-have Teamtailor merch, free breakfast and fika

  • The opportunity to work with a talented, fun and kind group of individuals, based in our Farringdon office

If this sounds like you, then you know what to do!

item.title: Revenue Systems Engineer
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

About the role

The Revenue Systems Engineer designs, builds and maintains the configuration, logic and integrations that run our revenue systems.

Revenue Systems runs the tools that about 440 people across many teams use every day, from Sales and Customer Success to Finance and Data: Salesforce as our hub, and around it tools for conversation intelligence, scheduling, enrichment, contracts, billing and customer success. We are turning the team into a product team, where each tool has an owner, a direction and outcomes we measure.

In this role, you work across the whole stack: Salesforce configuration and code, integrations between our tools, and the data that flows through them. You are involved early in discovery and take solutions all the way to production.

Key responsibilities

  • Build. Design and deliver Salesforce configuration and code, including objects, fields, validation rules, permissions, Flow, Apex and Lightning Web Components, using configuration where it is sufficient and code where it is needed.

  • Integrations. Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and the other tools in our stack.

  • Technical discovery. Take part in discovery with a product manager, assessing technical feasibility, options and the effort to build and maintain a solution.

  • Quality and delivery. Write tests, deploy through source control and our deployment pipeline, and follow the team's design and coding standards.

  • Platform support. Take part in the system support process, troubleshooting platform issues escalated from first-line support and resolving their root cause.

  • Automation. Identify and build automation that removes manual work for our users.

  • Documentation. Document solutions so that others can understand, support and extend them.

Expected impact

Within your first months, we expect you to:

  • Deliver changes to production independently, to the team's standards

  • Bring technical insight to discovery that leads to better solutions

  • Help reduce recurring platform issues by fixing their root causes

Requirements

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement listed below.

Must have

  • Solid declarative Salesforce configuration: objects, fields, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets and complex Flow

  • Hands-on Salesforce development, including Apex with test classes and Lightning Web Components

  • Experience building or consuming REST APIs

  • Ability to troubleshoot production issues and identify their root cause

  • Clear documentation and communication skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building integrations outside Salesforce, using middleware, an integration platform (iPaaS), or scripting in Python or JavaScript

  • SQL and data migration experience

  • Experience with the APIs of sales, marketing or customer success tools

  • Test automation

  • Interest in using AI to automate business processes

  • Certifications are not required.

Collaboration

You work closely with product managers, administrators and other engineers in Revenue Systems, from discovery through to release and support. Your designs are reviewed within the team before they are built, and you work with business stakeholders to understand how our systems are used day to day.

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

item.title: Revenue Systems Product Manager
item.description:
Join us to shape the future!

Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide. 🌍

Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company. 🎉🥳

About the role

The Revenue Systems Product Manager makes sure that what we build solves well-framed business problems and delivers measurable value.

Revenue Systems runs the tools that about 440 people across many teams use every day, from Sales and Customer Success to Finance and Data: Salesforce as our hub, and around it tools for conversation intelligence, scheduling, enrichment, contracts, billing and customer success. We are turning the team into a product team, where each tool has an owner, a direction and outcomes we measure.

In this role, you shape how we understand a problem, who we involve, and what has to be true before anyone starts building. You help the business frame the problems worth solving, map business processes to the systems that support them, and turn that understanding into clear priorities and requirements.

Key responsibilities

  • Discovery. Lead discovery for new initiatives and significant changes, using structured methods such as workshops, stakeholder mapping, business process mapping and written discovery briefs. Continuously improve how the team runs discovery.

  • Problem framing. Build a deep understanding of the business and help stakeholders define the problem, its impact and its success criteria before solutions are discussed.

  • Process and systems mapping. Map business processes to the systems that support them, and identify gaps, overlaps and opportunities across the stack.

  • Requirements. Translate business needs into user stories, functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and lead acceptance testing, including with implementation partners.

  • Backlog and prioritisation. Own the Revenue Systems backlog, review and scope incoming requests, and prioritise based on business value, risk and effort.

  • Roadmap. Contribute to the Revenue Systems roadmap and its sequencing, surfacing dependencies and trade-offs.

  • Configuration governance. Define, for the tools you own, which changes business administrators can make themselves.

  • Hands-on configuration. Deliver a defined share of declarative configuration and automation in Salesforce and adjacent tools.

Expected impact

Within your first months, we expect you to make a visible difference to how the team works:

  • A consistent discovery approach applied to new initiatives

  • Clearly framed problems and requirements, leading to less rework after build

  • Shared visibility of priorities and the reasoning behind them

Requirements

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every requirement listed below.

Must have

  • Experience in product management, product ownership or business analysis for business systems, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Structured discovery and requirements work: workshop facilitation, process mapping, user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Backlog management and prioritisation based on value, risk and effort

  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model and declarative configuration

  • Knowledge of revenue lifecycle management: quoting, contracting, subscriptions, amendments, renewals and billing

  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience establishing or improving a discovery or product practice within a team

  • Experience implementing a CPQ, revenue lifecycle management or subscription billing solution

  • Experience working with implementation partners

  • Experience with a multi-tool go-to-market stack beyond Salesforce

  • Framing automation or AI use cases with measurable outcomes

Certifications are not required.

Collaboration

You work closely with the engineers and administrators in Revenue Systems, pairing with engineers during discovery so that solutions are technically sound before they are built. Outside the team, you partner with RevOps process owners and the business teams who rely on our tools, from commercial teams to Finance and Data, to align on priorities, dependencies and sequencing.

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!
